ModMetaData.name: Wraith & Nanite Gravtech
ModMetaData.author: Vardath
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial, non-commercial fan-made RimWorld 1.6 mod inspired by Stargate Atlantis themes. Adds regenerative life-draining Wraith xenotypes, host-grown biotechnology, small and human-form Replicators, original Wraith and precursor equipment, independent shuttlecraft, and Odyssey-native gravship technology families.
Requires Biotech and Odyssey. Ideology is optional and only required for the Neural Interface Enslave operation. CatCraft's Stargates! is optional; when present, WNG hostile factions can use its existing Stargate raid arrival system rather than adding or replacing Stargates. ONAC is also optional; when ONAC and its RimGate Jaffa requirement are present, WNG can recognise their externally owned factions and pawn state through a dependency-free compatibility surface. WNG does not add or duplicate Goa'uld, Tok'ra or Jaffa systems and does not require ONAC, RimGate or Harmony.
All shipped WNG code, runtime art and procedural audio are project-created for this mod. No official logos, ripped models, screenshots, dialogue, music or sound recordings are included.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Stargate rights holders, Ludeon Studios, or any associated rights holder.
